title.en: What we collect when you contact us

body.en:
When you send an enquiry through our contact form, we receive the details you type in: your name, email address, company, role, company size and your message.

With the enquiry we also record the page you sent it from (without any tracking codes in the address), the time, the language of the page, and your cookie choices. If you have accepted analytics cookies, we also record how you first and most recently found our site (for example a search engine or a campaign link), as described under "Cookies and similar storage", and your Google Analytics identifier, which links your enquiry to your earlier visits in our analytics.

To protect the form from spam and abuse, your IP address is checked by Cloudflare Turnstile and used to limit how many submissions can come from one address. We don't store it with your enquiry.

We use your enquiry to reply to you and to discuss the work you asked about. Under the DPDP Act, you give us these details voluntarily for that purpose. Under the GDPR, where it applies, our legal basis is taking steps at your request before entering into a contract, and our legitimate interest in answering business enquiries.

We send you marketing emails only if you tick the box on the form. That box is never ticked for you, and we keep a record of the exact wording you agreed to and when. You can unsubscribe from any email at any time.

Cloudflare hosts this website and runs the service that receives the form. It checks submissions for spam with Cloudflare Turnstile, keeps a short-term copy of each enquiry (the Lead Log) and sends us an email alert about it. That alert, with your details, stays in our business mailbox.

Brevo stores enquiries as our contact records and sends our emails.

CookieYes shows the cookie banner and keeps a record of your cookie choices.

Google (Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics) measures how the site is used, and only if you accept analytics cookies.

Each of them processes the data only to provide their service to us. [TO FILL: confirm each provider's data processing terms and processing locations during review.]

The short-term copy of your enquiry (the Lead Log) is deleted automatically after 90 days. The email alert about it is kept in our mailbox for [TO FILL: how long alert emails are kept, decided during review].

In Brevo we keep your contact record for [TO FILL: retention period decided during review], or until you ask us to delete it. Your cookie choices are kept by CookieYes for [TO FILL: CookieYes consent record retention].

Nothing that tracks you runs until you accept it in the cookie banner, and you can change your choice at any time from the "Cookie settings" link at the bottom of every page.

If you accept analytics cookies, Google Analytics sets its own cookies, and our site keeps a note in your browser of how you first and most recently arrived (for example "google / organic" or a campaign name) for 90 days. It never stores your name, email or phone number. If you also accept advertising cookies, that note can include the ad click identifier in the link you followed. Withdrawing your consent deletes the note.

The spam check (Cloudflare Turnstile) is needed to protect the form, so it runs without a cookie choice.

Our providers may process data outside India, including in the European Union and the United States. Cloudflare processes requests at locations worldwide. [TO FILL: confirm the transfer mechanisms and any countries restricted under the DPDP Act during review.]

Under the DPDP Act you can ask us for a summary of the personal data we hold about you and how we use it, ask us to correct, complete or erase it, withdraw your consent, nominate someone to act for you, and have a grievance addressed. If we don't resolve it, you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

If the GDPR applies to you, you can also ask for access, correction, erasure, restriction or a copy of your data, object to our use of it, and complain to your data protection authority.

To use any of these rights, email [TO FILL: privacy contact email]. We will answer within [TO FILL: response time decided during review].
